title: Round-trip Flight Search Harness request v4

adult_count.description: Number of adult travelers. Child and infant fares are not supported.

overnight_allowed.description: Whether a connection wait may cross a local calendar day; destination stay nights are controlled separately.

outbound_departure_window.description: Date-only boundaries require utc_offset on every origin anchor node.

return_departure_window.description: Date-only boundaries require utc_offset on every destination anchor node.

minimum_stay_nights.description: Minimum difference between the destination-local arrival date and first return-departure date.

maximum_stay_nights.description: Maximum difference between the destination-local arrival date and first return-departure date.

budget.description: Optional inclusive hard ceiling for the complete mandatory round-trip price; null means no ceiling.

maximum_outbound_duration_minutes.description: Inclusive elapsed-time ceiling for the complete outbound journey.

maximum_return_duration_minutes.description: Inclusive elapsed-time ceiling for the complete return journey.

airport_transit_unknown_policy.description: Unknown transit feasibility may remain an explicitly unverified candidate or be rejected; it is never confirmed transit eligibility.
